title: Book a Meeting
subtitle: Sit with our team at the office, walk the site with an engineer, or take it over a video call. Whatever suits you.

modes.name: Site Visit
modes.description: Walk the project with the site engineer. Hard hat and safety gear provided.

modes.name: Office Meeting
modes.description: Meet at Ma Krupa House, Ring Road. Drawings, samples and cost sheets on the table.

modes.name: Video Call
modes.description: A screen-shared walkthrough of plans and pricing. Ideal for outstation and NRI buyers.

modes.name: Phone Callback
modes.description: A quick call at a time you pick, to answer specific questions before you commit an hour.

assurance: Confirmation on WhatsApp within 2 working hours
No obligation and no registration fee
Site visits include pick-up from our office on request
Meetings available in English, Hindi and Gujarati
